verdict.rationale: Zulip lets you choose where data lives by self-hosting the same software as Zulip Cloud on a system of your choice, and its export/import tools let you move freely between Zulip Cloud and your own servers. This gives full control over data location, though only through self-hosting. Missing for 10: region selection within hosted Zulip Cloud, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration of residency use cases.
